<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Outbound trouble never silences inbound. Backoff is computed in one place from the attempt count and the server's hint, with an injected clock; tests never sleep in wall time. The queue keeps its ordering guarantee explicitly. Fakes stand in for Telegram everywhere; no test, and no coder, contacts the real API. |
| composition_root | — |
| contracts | — |

| rk-0001 | A store schema change (e.g. an attempt counter) needs a migration. | Prefer existing columns; if a migration is needed, say so to the prime BEFORE writing it (the store is backed up before merging any migration). |
